newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Sberbank up 10 pct, liquidity low.
newsitem.headline: Russia Sberbank up 10 pct, liquidity low.

text.p: Shares of Russia's biggest bank Sberbank rose over 10 percent by midday on Thursday as investors scrambled for the newly-listed shares.
Sberbank, Russia's dominant savings bank and the only one traded on the Russian Trading System, has seen high demand in the last week but few sellers, traders say.
It had risen to $185.00 at 0929 GMT from $168.00 at the close on Wednesday. About $250,000 had traded.
Sberbank said last week it intended to tap foreign capital markets in the autumn but gave no details.
